items.title: Josiah "Cie" Frazier Interview
items.q: I was playing with that outfit, you know, different spot jobs, yeah, with Bunk and George and them.

ctx.x: Did you ever play with Bunk? I guess not the old days.

Not the old days. I played with Bunk, yeah. And after he, George and I came back from New York. That was another thing I forgot right after the wall, I was playing with that outfit, you know, different spot jobs, yeah, with Bunk and George and them. And I made that trip that time with George to California, remember? Oh yeah. That was in 56. George went replacing Joe Boston, the drummer. Well I played up there with them and came on back.
Did you ever enjoy joining Earl Hines?

items.title: Josiah 'Cie' Frazier Interview, 1961-02-16
items.q: the first concert we played at the St. Charles Hotel was with Bunk Johnson and the George Lewis band

ctx.x: Did you find yourself okay in that band?

Same, it's like, you didn't change from that same thing, you know, just want to have more men, you understand. Yeah, just more men, just like when I come out of the Navy band, the first, not a recording, but the first concert we played at the St. Charles Hotel was with Bunk Johnson and the George Lewis band, yeah. First night that you came in town, yeah, same trouble, baby, baby, baby, the doctor didn't come down, yeah. Oh. And they just come from making a tour in New York. I went to play, went to St. Charles…
Louis made a record with him, didn't he, with that, with that same band?
